SUPPLIER OPERATIONS
Industry context · Taiwan / Shanghai
From lot records to the next operating decision

For semiconductor equipment-component suppliers, progress and quality information becomes useful when the source, scope and decision owner are clear.

Illustration made for this page: silicon crystal, wafers, epitaxy and production records. Not a photo of Wafer Works or its equipment.

01
Where to start

Start with one handoff

Choose one production lot and the planning decision that needs its progress or quality status. Identify the source record, when it was updated, and what it covers.

Agree who checks a mismatch, who receives the confirmed information and what evidence they need before the next step.

02
Roles and responsibilities

Keep planning and production evidence in their roles

ERP supports enterprise orders, materials, planning and costs. Manufacturing execution solutions support production progress, lot records and quality information.

Map the information each team needs before defining the solution scope and data handoff.

03
Industry context

Semiconductor industry context: Wafer Works

Wafer Works / 合晶科技, Taiwan / Shanghai, produces silicon wafer materials. The case covers crystal growth, wafer processing and epitaxy.

Digiwin describes production genealogy from silicon crystals to wafer lots, visibility into production progress and equipment status, and epitaxy history with quality parameter limits.

For an equipment-component supplier, these are useful questions about traceability and execution visibility to bring into its own process discussion.

Wafer Works / 合晶科技

TALK WITH DIGIWIN VIETNAM

Define the fit with the team in Vietnam

Digiwin Vietnam specialists assess factory operations, advise on business processes and support on-site solution transfer and factory acceptance.

Bring a current production-to-planning handoff to the discussion: its records, the people involved, the receiving decision and the gaps to resolve. This helps define the processes and implementation scope for your factory.

checks.h1: 系統交接前，先釐清紀錄歸屬
checks.text:
跳至案例正文
製造業數位化方案
Tiếng Việt
English
简体中文
繁體中文
供應商系統
產業脈絡 · 台灣 / 上海
系統交接前，先釐清紀錄歸屬

半導體設備零組件供應商的工廠 IT 與營運團隊，需要共同釐清紀錄定義、維護責任及接收方決策。

本頁專用示意圖：矽晶體、晶圓、磊晶與生產紀錄。並非Wafer Works或其設備的照片。

01
從何開始

從一筆生產紀錄開始

選定排程或品質團隊需要的一筆紀錄，釐清其定義、更新時間及生產範圍。

確認由哪個團隊與系統維護、誰核對差異，以及誰確認交接。

02
角色與權責

區分企業與生產的責任

ERP 支援企業訂單、物料、規劃與成本管理。製造執行解決方案支援生產進度、批次紀錄及品質資訊。

用這些角色梳理紀錄責任與流程需求。先與工廠團隊界定技術範圍，再選擇資訊交接方式。

03
產業脈絡

產業脈絡：Wafer Works

Wafer Works / 合晶科技在台灣 / 上海生產矽晶圓材料，涵蓋晶體生長、晶圓加工及磊晶。

案例將矽晶體連結到各晶圓批次的生產履歷，並呈現進度、設備狀態及設有品質參數限值的磊晶紀錄。

工廠團隊可據此釐清自身流程討論需要關注的生產紀錄及責任。

Wafer Works / 合晶科技

與DIGIWIN越南交流

與越南團隊界定本廠範圍

Digiwin 越南團隊評估工廠營運、提供業務流程建議，並支援現場方案移交及工廠驗收。

帶上一項現有資訊交接、紀錄維護方、接收方決策及待核對差異，共同梳理流程與實施範圍。

參考來源

Digiwin 半導體解決方案：Wafer Works

Digiwin 越南：供應商解決方案與在地服務

Scope the customer question before collecting records

For PCB suppliers serving semiconductor and electronics equipment, quality and operating teams need clear record scope, sources and review responsibility.

Illustration made for this page: silicon crystal, wafers, epitaxy and production records. Not a photo of Wafer Works or its equipment.

01
Where to start

Define the customer question

Identify the lot, process step, time period and information requested. Use this scope to decide which records matter to the response.

Name who compares those records with the request, who resolves differences and who confirms the response.

02
Roles and responsibilities

Separate enterprise and production records

ERP supports enterprise orders, materials, planning and costs. Manufacturing execution solutions support production progress, lot records and quality information.

Identify the team or system maintaining each relevant source. Agree review responsibilities and unresolved gaps with factory teams before defining the solution scope.

03
Industry context

Industry context: Wafer Works

Wafer Works / 合晶科技 in Taiwan / Shanghai produces silicon wafer materials through crystal growth, wafer processing and epitaxy.

The case connects silicon crystals to wafer-lot production history and provides visibility into progress, equipment status and epitaxy records with quality parameter limits.

This silicon-materials context helps quality teams discuss production record sources and scope. A PCB factory must define the records relevant to its own customer question.

Wafer Works / 合晶科技

Discuss your factory scope with the Vietnam team

Digiwin Vietnam assesses factory operations, advises on business processes and supports on-site solution transfer and factory acceptance.

Bring one customer lot question, the relevant record sources, a review owner and unresolved gaps to a discussion of your process and implementation scope.
